title: The Best iMessage APIs in 2026: Complete Comparison
summary: Compare every iMessage API provider: Sendblue, Linq, Blooio, Project Blue, Texting Blue, and more. Features, pricing, compliance, and recommendations.
body_markdown:
**Best for:** Businesses of any size, AI agents, sales teams, healthcare, enterprises


Sendblue is the largest and longest-running iMessage API provider. With 5+ years in production and thousands of customers (including publicly traded companies), it offers the most comprehensive feature set: iMessage with RCS and SMS fallback, contact card delivery,[FaceTime Audio calling](https://www.sendblue.com/products/calling) , group messaging, and native integrations with 6+ CRMs.


Sendblue is the only provider offering both SOC 2 compliance and HIPAA support, making it the clear choice for regulated industries. Pricing starts at approximately $100/month for a dedicated line — significantly cheaper than all competitors.
